ambushTraps.prompt: Why do you think you keep failing?
What is the one thing you are most afraid of people finding out about you?
Why are you still doing this to yourself?
What excuse are you going to give me today?
Who have you disappointed the most this month — and why?
What are you avoiding right now that you promised yourself you'd finish?
If you were being completely honest, what would you admit you're too weak to change?
Tell me why you deserve another chance — and why I should believe you this time.
Describe the last time you quit on yourself. What did you tell yourself so you could walk away?
ambushTraps.hint: The story you use. All of it.
